Fixes #1644

The deleted-transport dialog regression test now waits for the footer Close button to own focus with the default bounded `vi.waitFor`. The previous immediate assertion could run before the focus effect under load. The exact target and accessible-description assertions remain intact.

## 📋 Scope

One assertion in `src/components/modules/transports/__tests__/leg-dialog.test.tsx`. Production focus behavior, copy, persistence and runner configuration are unchanged.

Previous implementation step passed the targeted file (22 tests), typecheck, lint (existing unrelated `room-refresh.ts:63` no-shadow warning), server (6406 tests), tooling (783 tests), all four sequential UI shards (6748 tests), generated-file check and production build. The unsharded UI run reached its 540-second process limit; all UI files subsequently passed in shards. A temporary negative control suppressing button focus failed at the exact assertion and was removed. The historical intermittent failure was not reproduced in the baseline run.

PR preparation verified the one-line diff, clean worktree, validation log summaries and docs grep. Browser/E2E checks were not run. Draft for the next review/QA chain step; `needs-qa` follows the repository path rule.

Escalation: no. |

None.

fix: store booleans in the edge styles set by GraphLayout

`GraphLayout.setEdgeStyleEnabled` and `GraphLayout.setOrthogonalEdge` stored the strings `'0'` and `'1'` in the boolean `noEdgeStyle` and `orthogonal` styles. Both strings are truthy, so `setEdgeStyleEnabled(edge, true)` disabled the edge style and `setOrthogonalEdge(edge, false)` made the edge orthogonal. It went unnoticed because the maxGraph layouts only call these methods with the values that happened to work (`setEdgeStyleEnabled(edge, false)` and `setOrthogonalEdge(edge, true)`).

### This is a regression from mxGraph

mxGraph writes the same strings ([mxGraphLayout.js#L283-L298](https://github.com/jgraph/mxgraph/blob/ff141aab158417bd866e2dfebd06c61d40773cd2/javascript/src/js/layout/mxGraphLayout.js#L283-L298)), but into a style string such as `noEdgeStyle=0`, that its stylesheet parses back into numbers ([mxStylesheet.js#L240-L243](https://github.com/jgraph/mxgraph/blob/ff141aab158417bd866e2dfebd06c61d40773cd2/javascript/src/js/view/mxStylesheet.js#L240-L243)). So `0` was falsy when [mxGraphView.getEdgeStyle](https://github.com/jgraph/mxgraph/blob/ff141aab158417bd866e2dfebd06c61d40773cd2/javascript/src/js/view/mxGraphView.js#L1511) and `mxGraph.isOrthogonal` read it. draw.io still works this way today ([mxGraphLayout.js](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio/blob/3e707fd20b6930778d6f6bf6e4d0079b4bce366b/src/main/webapp/mxgraph/src/layout/mxGraphLayout.js#L282-L297), [mxStylesheet.js](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio/blob/3e707fd20b6930778d6f6bf6e4d0079b4bce366b/src/main/webapp/mxgraph/src/view/mxStylesheet.js#L250-L253)).

maxGraph styles are objects, so nothing parses the strings any more and they are read as they are.

### Changes

- Both methods now store booleans, which gives back the behavior of mxGraph, and their `value` parameter is typed as `boolean` instead of `any`.
- Tests check the observable behavior (`GraphView.getEdgeStyle` and `AbstractGraph.isOrthogonal`). They fail without the fix.
- The CHANGELOG documents the change under "Behavior Changes", since code calling these methods directly or reading these styles in `cell.style` sees the difference.

### Notes

Found while working on #1028, whose stricter typing of `setCellStyles` no longer accepts these strings. #1028 should be merged after this PR.

fix(web): open the phone tour sheet away from the target it scrolls to (#209)

Closes #209

## 🎯 What changes
On phones the tip of a product tour step is a sheet. Its edge was fixed per step (`phoneSheetSide`, set only for the bottom navigation), so a target the tour scrolled to the bottom of the screen – Organization tour, steps 2 and 3 – kept a bottom sheet that covered the lower part of the target and its ring. §2.9 requires that *a tip about an element at the bottom edge opens at the top edge*.

The side is now decided from where the target lands after the scroll (`tourSheetSide`, `product-tour.ts`): a target below the viewport lands at the bottom scroll margin, one above it at the top margin, any other stays put. A target whose centre ends in the lower half gets the sheet at the top edge – the bottom navigation included – any other the bottom edge. The prediction gives the same answer for the landing box, so it does not matter whether the tip measures before, during or after the smooth scroll; that is why it is computed when the tip renders (as the anchor is read), not stored from an effect (`react-hooks/set-state-in-effect`).

## 📋 Scope
`apps/web/src/features/product-tours` only. The static `phoneSheetSide` step field is removed (`first-login.ts`); the scroll-margin read is shared with the ring decision (`scrollMarginOf`). `TourTip` (`@trybun/ui`) is unchanged – it already supports `sheetSide="top"`. Tablet and desktop are unchanged: the side applies only to the sheet.

## 🧪 Validation
- Unit: `tourSheetSide` `it.each` (below/partly below/above the viewport, bottom navigation, header, tall targets).
- E2E (`product-tours.spec.ts`, phone/tablet/desktop – 21 passed locally): the target box plus the 5 px ring does not overlap the tip in steps 2–3 of the Organization tour and every step of Getting started. Without the fix the new assertion fails on the phone.
- Gate: `pnpm lint`, `lint:spec`, `typecheck`, `test`, `build` green. `pnpm test:coverage`: 2 failures in `apps/web/src/app/api/auth/backchannel-logout/route.integration.spec.ts`, reproduced locally on unmodified `main` (the `web-integration` project) and passing when the file runs alone; unrelated to this change (main CI is green) – CI is the reference.

fix(messenger): let a click join or leave a custom emoji reaction

## What

Clicking or tapping a reaction chip drawn from a company's custom emoji now adds or removes your reaction, the same as a Unicode emoji chip.

## Why

`toggleWhenJoinable` in `message-reactions.svelte` ignored every reaction that carried an image, so custom emoji chips did nothing when pressed, on phones and computers alike. chatd already adds a custom emoji reaction by its shortcode and removes it by the same name, so the guard only blocked a path the messenger supports.

## Verification

- `bunx playwright test tests/e2e/messenger/custom-emoji-images.spec.ts tests/e2e/messenger/messenger-reaction-people.spec.ts`: 6 passed.
- `bun run check`: 0 errors.
- `git diff --check`: clean.
- No test toggles a reaction end to end, because the mocked messenger plane cannot change reactions. The click path was not exercised against a real messenger.
- `make check` was not run.

### 원인 확인
- CI 기록(#1337의 상자 기록): `section.board 12,328 296x472 → 0,0 0x0 (247ms, 깨기 310ms 전)`. 흔들림 상자는 화면 안으로 잘라 적으므로 `0x0`은 표가 사라진 것이 아니라 **화면(높이 800) 밖으로 밀려난 것**이고, 시각이 **하이드레이션보다 310ms 앞**이라 React가 아닌 브라우저가 첫 HTML을 그리는 동안의 일입니다.
- 860px 이하에서 품목 상세(`.side`)는 `order: -1`로 표 **위에** 보이지만, 페이지(HTML)에서는 표 **뒤**에 있습니다(운영 첫 HTML 기준 표 52,025바이트, 상세 69,050바이트). 응답이 중간에서 나뉘어 오면 브라우저는 앞부분(표까지)을 먼저 그리고, 늦게 도착한 상세를 표 위에 끼워 넣어 이미 그려진 표를 아래로 밉니다. 네트워크가 어디서 나뉘느냐에 달려 드물게만 났습니다.
- 서스펜스·지연 로딩·CSS 늦은 도착이 아님을 확인했습니다(시세 화면에는 서스펜스 경계·lazy가 없고, 머리글·시세 CSS는 첫 HTML의 렌더 차단 `<link>`에 있음).

## 🚀 주요 변경 사항
> 완료한 이슈 번호 \
> Close #1353

Close #1353

  - 860px 이하 `.side`에 `overflow-anchor: none`: 정렬로 상세가 새 품목으로 바뀔 때 잠깐 줄어드는 높이를, 전에는 브라우저가 표를 기준으로 스크롤을 맞춰 가렸습니다. 상세가 앞에 오자 기준이 상세 안으로 잡혀 표가 움직였습니다(로컬 a7-controls /market @360 정렬/고가 6/6 실패). 기준을 표에 두어 전과 같게 했습니다.

+# Issue 8526 — telemetry pg probe lifecycle
+
+Summary: The PostgreSQL instrumentation child can await a query forever after a failed connection.
+
+Root cause: `pg` connection failure rejects `connect()` without clearing queryability. Socket close drains existing queries once. If socket close precedes the later `query()`, that query is enqueued after the last drain and never settles. Reproduced under Node 24.19.0 by awaiting the client end event before the existing query: last diagnostic stage query, exit 13 with unsettled top-level await. Normal ordering produces actual pg.query spans. CI has no phase diagnostics and times out before SPANS; its exact event order is unavailable, but the race is deterministic locally.
+
+Files to change:
+- packages/telemetry/src/__tests__/pg-instrumentation.test.ts — explicitly close failed client, cover both event orderings, capture safe lifecycle stages, require clean child exit and SDK shutdown.
+
+Approach: Preserve default provider instrumentations and the actual bound-parameter query. Close the failed client before querying so pg rejects through its real instrumented query path regardless of socket timing. Disable unrelated test log/metric exporters via existing seams, remove arbitrary delay/forced exit, and verify normal SDK shutdown. Test socket-end ordering fails without explicit close.
+
+Risks: Test-only lifecycle correction; no runtime API/schema/instrumentation config changes. Hosted full-suite confirmation remains CI evidence, distinct from repeated local passes.
+
+## Execution plan
+- [x] Read guidance, check concurrency, identify blocked stage.
+- [x] Implement and repeat targeted regression tests with original query-span/redaction assertions.
+- [x] Attempt ordered validation and record the failures and limits below. PR publication, review, and claim release are tracked in the tracker run report.
+
+## Regression evidence
+
+- Node 24.19.0: `yarn workspace @open-mercato/telemetry test --runInBand pg-instrumentation` passes 10/10 consecutive invocations (both cases each time).
+- Node 24.19.0: `yarn workspace @open-mercato/telemetry test` passes 3/3 consecutive invocations, 21 suites / 165 tests each.
+- Mutation check: remove the explicit pre-query `client.end()` and run `yarn workspace @open-mercato/telemetry test --runInBand pg-instrumentation -t socket-ended`: fails at `STAGE=query`, exit 13, unsettled top-level await. Restore close: both cases pass.
+- `processor.forceFlush()` replaces the arbitrary 250 ms delay; in-memory exports can await resource detection, so reading immediately without flushing is premature.
+- Client and SDK cleanup replace `process.exit(0)`; parent rejects timeout, nonzero exit, or signal even if SPANS appeared.
+- Missing build output now fails instead of silently skipping coverage.
+
+## Repository validation (local runner)
+
+The configured ordered gate was attempted. Both `yarn build:packages` executions, `yarn generate`, `yarn typecheck`, scoped telemetry typecheck, and template parity passed. The cockpit's long temporary-directory path initially prevents `tsx` from binding its Unix socket (`listen EINVAL`); `TMPDIR=/tmp` resolves that environment failure for translation sync and template parity.
+
+With the short temporary path, `yarn i18n:check-sync` passes, while `yarn i18n:check-usage` reaches the 300-second process bound without a result. `yarn test` exits 1 at `packages/cli/src/lib/generators/__tests__/agent-files-extension.test.ts:609`: the no-output-root case expected a warning, but recorded zero calls. This lies outside the changed telemetry files; no baseline waiver or complete-suite pass is claimed. `yarn build:app` passes (203.6 seconds). Hosted full-suite evidence and PR review are recorded in the PR/run report.
